messages:
maria: Quick announce — we just pushed community-eval-harness v0.1-alpha to GitHub. 🎉

maria: repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-eval-harness

maria: TL;DR: lightweight eval harness for running prompt/metric suites against models, CI hooks, Redwood API examples, and a small set of curated workloads (classification, summarization, safety checks).

maria: Goals: make it trivial for community contributors to add evals, reproduce regressions, and set up automated quality gates for model rollouts.

dev-bot: release-bot published community-eval-harness v0.1-alpha — changelog: added CLI, initial metrics (EM, ROUGE, token-coverage), Redwood API adapter, and CI action.

jake: huge! any gotchas to be aware of for Dedicated/private deployments?

maria: good q — the harness runs locally or in CI, and we included an adapter that shows how to call Redwood Hosted and Dedicated. For Private, you need to set REDWOOD_API_URL + bearer token in env. Docs have a short section.

sasha: can we get a sample workflow for running evals on canary traffic? would help platform teams.

maria: yes — added an example workflow in .github/workflows/canary-eval.yml. It demonstrates downloading a snapshot of prompts, calling the model via the Redwood adapter, and failing build on regression thresholds.

toni: I skimmed the code. Looks small and well-documented. Interested in maintaining the safety checks set.

kevin: I can help wire up the Redwood Console integration so eval results are visible in dashboards (token usage + regression alerts).

maria: amazing — @toni @kevin let's coordinate. I'm planning a 30-min community sync next Tue (12:30 PT) to onboard new maintainers and discuss contribution guidelines.

jake: can we add a CONTRIBUTING template that specifies evaluation dataset licensing and PII checks?

maria: yes — licensing + privacy checklist included in docs. Please file an issue if you find gaps.

sasha: small nit: the default metrics are configurable, right? want to add BLEURT for summarization bench.

maria: configurable via config.yml, and we have hooks for custom metrics. PRs welcome for BLEURT + eval runners.

dev-bot: CI check passed on main for v0.1-alpha.

toni: I'll open the first PR to add more safety tests and a few curated prompts.

kevin: I'll prototype a Redwood Console panel for eval-trends and ping infra for permissions.

maria: thanks all. If folks from the community want to join maintainers, reply here or drop into #devex. We'll publish a short post on the community forum tomorrow with the release notes and meeting link.

jake: :thumbsup:

sasha: :rocket:

maria: link to meeting + notes will be shared in #announcements and the repo. Cheers!
